item.title: Pigeonhole 1.4.1
item.description:
• The waiting-tabs window now stays minimised. Chrome and Edge on the Mac had been opening it as an ordinary window.
  • If something brings it forward (clicking Chrome in the Dock, say), it goes back down and the window you were using comes forward, or a new window when it was the only one.
  • When Chrome starts, the waiting window it brings back from last time is closed right away. Nothing is lost: every space is saved.
